name: count-playwright-AJ
description: Production-ready Playwright automation framework for COUNT (dev-app.getcount.com)
author: COUNT QA Team

scripts.test:dev: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test
scripts.test:prod: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:smoke: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/smoke/ --workers=4
scripts.test:prod:smoke: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/smoke/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:e2e: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/e2e/ --workers=4
scripts.test:prod:e2e: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/e2e/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:sanity: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/sanity/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:crud: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/invoices/ tests/bills/ tests/transactions/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:settings: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/settings/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:regression: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/regression/ --workers=4
scripts.test:prod:regression: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/regression/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:a11y: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/a11y/ --workers=1
scripts.test:prod:a11y: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/a11y/ --workers=1
scripts.test:dev:visual: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/ --workers=1
scripts.test:prod:visual: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/visual/ --workers=1
scripts.auth:dev: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test --project=auth-setup --headed
scripts.auth:prod: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test --project=auth-setup --headed
scripts.test:ci:regression: npx playwright test tests/regression/ tests/e2e/ tests/reports/ --reporter=html,json
